answer: The model uses $h$ attention heads, where the keys and queries for each head have a dimension of $d_k$ [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 4, §3.2.2 Multi-Head Attention]. In the encoder-decoder attention layers, the queries come from the previous decoder layer, while the keys and values come from the output of the encoder [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 5, §3.2.3 Applications of Attention in our Model].
